assessment: require no sample cherry-picking; record all 119/249, linked keys, overlap, extra symbols, DD and worst streak for both stages; staged improvement must exceed baseline Net and nonworse DD/PF on SAME full pinned opportunities to be accepted
cost_metrics: native published gross & realized_cost_bps x1 and x2; risk-scaled Liquid6 per-trade bps preserved, Delayed instrument bps preserved; extension adds stress carry scenario by elapsed extra hours, NOT observed funding
market_bars_source: original public BingX swap 1h via existing native evaluator read-only; save per-symbol SHA/UTC retrieval time; historical received_at UNKNOWN and never imputed
stage0: verify original saved entry at actual 1h open, TIMEOUT exit at actual 1h close, SL equal original geometry stop; canonical arrays must be continuous; otherwise fail closed

stage1_predeclared_rule.eligible: LONG, reason TIMEOUT, original terminal gross>=1.0 initial stop-price-R, original timeout candle completed, close>EMA20 and EMA20(current)>EMA20(previous)
stage1_predeclared_rule.same_symbol_ownership: if extended earlier exit now overlaps a later accepted saved candidate entry+2h cooldown, skip later candidate (do not invent new signals)
stage1_predeclared_rule.time_exit: last extra bar close, after verifying bar is fully closed; if incomplete, unchanged parent exit
stage1_predeclared_rule.trail_clock: stop on next bar uses only previous completed bar high; stop-first open-gap then low; update trailing at bar close only

stage2_predeclared_rule.action: reduce25 (0.75x existing position risk/notional), no skip, no order call
stage2_predeclared_rule.counter: last two previously CLOSED accepted trades at strictly earlier exit timestamps, both net-cost2 negative, both within prior 24h
stage2_predeclared_rule.same_timestamp_closes_at_entry: not counted until strictly earlier observed close
stage2_predeclared_rule.test: original baseline first, never fabricate retrading slots; optional combined only if stage1 independently improves both net & PF
